mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, order_no, order_status, original_amount, pay_amount FROM orders WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT id, order_id, product_id, sku_id, product_name, image, sales_price, quantity, sub_total, insurance_detail, insurance_fee, after_sale_status, after_sale_id FROM order_items WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT id, order_id, product_id, sku_id, product_name, image, sales_price, quantity, sub_total, insurance_detail, insurance_fee, after_sale_status, after_sale_id FROM order_items WHERE id = #{orderItemId} AND order_id = #{orderId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE products p SET p.stock = (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.stock), 0) FROM product_sku s WHERE s.product_id = p.id AND s.status = 1), p.update_time = NOW() WHERE p.id = #{productId}
